summary: QUALITY companion to Android PR #47, revised after two prior commits on this branch. ce181f0 appended 9 desk_android_* tools directly to contracts/tool-rosters/android.yaml, pushing it to 24 effective tools against G-7's [10, 15] cap. 0f814cb then fixed two Greptile-flagged P2s on those same roster tools (kind read -> write on the three capture tools; an explicit oneOf on desk_android_ui_tap's schema) without touching the tool count, so G-7 still failed. LEAD decision: keep the roster untouched and split the android/tools overflow into two contracts/tool-packs/*.yaml packs instead of raising ROSTER_MAX_TOOLS. This change reverts android.yaml to be byte-identical to origin/main (7 own + 8 core = 15 effective, superseding both ce181f0's addition and 0f814cb's on-roster fixes) and adds contracts/tool-packs/androidlocal.yaml (5 tools: emu_boot, adb_devices, install_apk, unit_test, instrumented_run) and contracts/tool-packs/androidmetavr.yaml (4 tools: logcat_capture, screenshot, ui_dump, ui_tap), loadable per ticket by bot-03-android via desk_app_tools_load. The two Greptile fixes from 0f814cb are preserved in the new location: androidmetavr's capture tools are kind write, and androidmetavr_ui_tap's schema enforces exactly one of resource_id/text via oneOf. The existing G-4 change document is updated in place (same change_id/filename) to describe the pack surfaces. android/** was not touched.

unverified: The `backend: android_cli.*` field on every new pack tool is a contract declaration only. No services/desk-gateway/** module implements it — there is no android_cli.py, and mobile.py (the module the prior commit's backend strings pointed at) is Play Console / App Store Connect only and does not cover android/tools. Wiring android_cli.* to shell out to `python -m android.tools <cmd>` (PR #47) is a SYSTEMS follow-up (services/desk-gateway/**, bot-01-systems-backend), not this QUALITY contract change.

androidmetavr.yaml's backend_kind/backend metavr path resolves a documented MetaVR tool id only; android/tools/metavr_bridge.py's device-connected check is hardcoded false ('Local-only bridge: never auto-detects a Quest/MetaVR device'), so every metavr-backed call in that pack raises DeviceUnavailable today, by design of PR #47 as it stands — these tools have never actually performed a capture or tap, and the pack's descriptions say so rather than implying otherwise.

androidlocal_unit_test and androidlocal_instrumented_run wrap android/tools/cli.py commands that print a skip line and exit 0 (reported as success) when no Gradle wrapper or device is available. That skip-is-exit-0 behavior belongs to PR #47's CLI and is out of scope for this contract-only change; both tool descriptions flag it so a caller reads the output rather than trusting a bare success signal.
No live adb, emulator, or Quest/MetaVR device was exercised — this change adds no runtime code, only YAML contract surfaces and one test-assertion fix.
desk_app_tools_load's live-tools ceiling (never exceed 20, per contracts/README.md) was not exercised against either new pack; that logic lives in the gateway's packs module, unmodified here.
